subject: NovumTech demo — vendor intake required before technical walkthrough

Subject: NovumTech demo — next steps and vendor intake

Hi Logan,

Appreciate the offer to run a deeper technical demo for our platform team next week. Before we can sign off on a live walkthrough we have two gating items from procurement/security:

- A completed security questionnaire (SSO, data residency, logging/retention)
- Exec-signed NDA (our legal team needs a company-level sig)

We started the questionnaire but the portal flagged a permission issue, so it shows as "incomplete". Also, our CISO will be traveling 9/23–9/27, and they'd like to attend the demo if possible. Given those constraints, can we move the demo out a week? Ideally to 10/1 or later so we can finish intake and have the CISO present.

I've attached the questionnaire we filled out so far and a short POC requirements spreadsheet. Let me know if you need anything else from our side to accelerate the intake.

Thanks,
Liam
Senior PM — Platform Integrations
NovumTech

Attachments: NovumTech_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf (application/pdf), NovumTech-POC-Requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the partially completed questionnaire. Totally fine to move the session so your CISO can join. We want the technical review to be productive rather than rushed.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll have Neha (security lead) review the attached questionnaire and follow up with any clarifying items by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa (solutions engineer) will confirm the slot availability and propose 3 alternate windows starting 10/1.
- If NovumTech can re-submit the portal entry, please include the invitation email from that system — if the permission issue looks like it came from our side we'll get the intake team to unblock it.

Proposed placeholders: 10/1 10:00–11:00am PT, 10/1 2:00–3:00pm PT, or 10/4 9:00–10:00am PT. Which of those is best for your exec?

I'll keep the thread short and loop in only the ops folks we need.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-23T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NovumTech demo — next steps and vendor intake

Logan / Marissa —

I reviewed the attached questionnaire and flagged three items that typically cause delays:

1) SSO / IdP integration: we need a list of expected identity providers and whether NovumTech requires Just-in-Time provisioning or SCIM. If they run a managed IdP (Okta/Azure), a SAML metadata URL will speed testing.
2) Data retention & access controls: please confirm whether NovumTech requires guaranteed region-bound storage for inference logs or if pseudonymization is sufficient for the pilot.
3) Audit logs: our standard SOC-level logging is available, but if procurement needs a snapshot/config export we can provide a sample retention policy doc.

I attached a short checklist and suggested answers for those fields to make the submission go faster. If you want, I can hop on a 30-minute call with Liam & Judy tomorrow to walk through the checklist so they can re-submit the portal entry correctly.

Marissa — once NovumTech confirms the travel window for the CISO, please propose the three concrete times (Logan's placeholders are good). I'll be on the call for the security section.

-Neha
Head of Security — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Intake_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Judy Harris <judy.harris@novumtech.com>

Subject: Re: NovumTech demo — next steps and vendor intake

Thanks, all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Liam looped me in; our CISO confirmed travel is now flexible and they can attend 10/01 10:00–11:00am PT. We re-submitted the questionnaire (portal confirmation attached) and included the SAML metadata URL for our Okta instance.

We can sign the corporate NDA today; I'll route DocuSign and mark Logan as the Redwood signee for the SOW/demo confidentiality exception. Please confirm the final invite and whether we should include any additional NovumTech product engineers on the session.

Judy
